users.bio: Alpine trails, morning mist over mountain valleys, and slow coastal train rides.
Earthen cups of ginger chai, sourdough crusts, and warm rain against window panes.
Campfire embers under the stars, weekend road trips, and sunset bicycle rides.
Life with golden retrievers and sunny windowsill cats. Keeping quiet paw prints.
Crispy street samosas, fresh morning spice markets, and hot tawa rotis.
Lotus raindrops during the monsoon, autumn forest paths, and starry skies.
Analog mechanical cameras, terracotta pottery clay, and leather-bound notebooks.
Watercolor studies, wildflower pressings, and finding calm in old bookshops.
